title: A new approach to interpolation of compact linear operators
summary: We prove an abstract theorem on keeping the compactness property of a linear operator after interpolation in Banach spaces. Our approach consists of two features. Applying the principle "reductio ad absurdum," we obtain a possibility to carry out all proofs only for some specially constructed subspaces of the given spaces, e.g., having a common Schauder basis. As a second feature, we consider in all assertions only embedding operators obtaining the full result just at the end of the paper.
